about_the_game:
“😎 For Anyone Who Wants Files Neatly in Place”

Spacer is a new file explorer that organizes your files with tags, while letting you manage them with priorities and memos.

｢🤔 Lost in countless folders?｣

Traditional folder structures are efficient for storing files, but have clear limits when it comes to searching.

Spacer solves this problem with a tag-based file management system.

｢✅ Core Feature: Tag-Based File Management｣

  • Tags: Attach tags to files to organize them flexibly.

  • Fast Search & Filtering: Combine tags to quickly find the files you need.

｢💡 Additional Features｣

  • Add Memos: Record short notes or ideas for each file.

  • Set Priorities: Highlight important files so they always stand out.

  • Pin to Top: Keep frequently used files pinned for instant access.

  • Quick Preview: Save time by checking key file contents without opening them.

｢👉 Demo Available｣

Spacer offers a demo version:

  • Create 1 space and up to 20 tags

  • All other features included

Try the demo to see if Spacer fits your workflow.

｢💬 Feedback｣

We want to make Spacer even better. Share your thoughts with us anytime.
